name: floppy
description: Floppy is a self-hosted, all-in-one media tracker: movies, TV, anime, manga, books, comics, games, board games, music, and podcasts in one library, history, and set of stats. A broader alternative to Trakt, Letterboxd, and TV Time. Requires a reachable Redis instance (used for caching and as the Celery broker). This is not bundled - run a Redis container on this same Unraid server (for example redis:8-alpine) with port 6379 published to the host. REDIS_URL defaults to host.docker.internal, which resolves to this server automatically, so no IP address needs to be entered - just make sure Redis' port is published to the host and matches the port in REDIS_URL. SQLite is used by default; PostgreSQL is supported via the DB_* variables. Set SECRET to a long random string before first run. See the README for the full environment variable list: https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy#configuration-and-deployment

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for SQLite database and local app data.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the Floppy web UI listens on.

variables.name: SECRET
variables.description: Long random string used as the Django secret key. Required.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: URL of a reachable Redis instance, used for caching and as the Celery broker. Defaults to this same server via host.docker.internal - just run a Redis container here with port 6379 published to the host. Change the port if you published Redis on a different one. Required.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone used for scheduling and displayed dates.

variables.name: REGISTRATION
variables.description: Allow new account sign-ups. Set to False after creating your account.

variables.name: DEMO_ACCOUNT_ENABLED
variables.description: Provision the public demo/demodemo account after migrations. Leave False unless you want it.

variables.name: TMDB_API
variables.description: TMDB API key for movie/TV metadata. Optional but recommended.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: PostgreSQL host. Leave blank to use SQLite instead.

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: PostgreSQL database name (only used when DB_HOST is set).

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: PostgreSQL user (only used when DB_HOST is set).

variables.name: DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: PostgreSQL password (only used when DB_HOST is set).

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: PostgreSQL port (only used when DB_HOST is set).

variables.name: URLS
variables.description: Public URL if using a reverse proxy, e.g. https://floppy.yourdomain.com

variables.name: ADMIN_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable the Django admin interface at /admin/.

variables.name: WEB_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Gunicorn worker processes. Leave blank - Floppy sizes this from the host's memory, CPU and swap. Each extra worker holds its own resident copy of the application. If this field already shows a number from an older template, clear it and apply.

variables.name: GUNICORN_THREADS
variables.description: Gunicorn threads per worker. Leave blank - Floppy sizes this from the host. A fixed 4 is too many for a small host, where the detected profile would use 2.

variables.name: DEBUG
variables.description: Enable Django debug mode. Leave False in production - it slows every request.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the container as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the container as.
